segments.sn52.7:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā anuruddho bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn52.7:1.4: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato anuruddhassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.sn52.7:2.1: “Cattārome, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattanti.
segments.sn52.7:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ –
segments.sn52.7:2.7: ime kho, āvuso, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattantī”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe sahassaṃ lokanti iminā therassa satata vihāro dassito.
Thero hi pātova mukhaṃ dhovitvā atītānāgate kappasahassaṃ anussarati.
Osadhibhāvāpekkhāya itthiliṅganiddeso, tabbahulatāya taṃ vanaṃ “kaṇḍakīvana”nteva paññāyittha.
Dasacakkavāḷasahassaṃ ekāvajjanassa āpāthaṃ āgacchati tathā ālokavaḍḍhanassa katattā. 9.
